items.docs:
Deletes an existing account in Pleo.

Only accounts not linked to any accounting entries can be deleted. Trying to delete an account linked to accounting entries will result in an error. If an account is linked, it can be archived instead. Use UPDATE endpoint to archive an account.

params.description: Upper bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [offset])

params.description: Offset of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [after])

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum amount of items to return

params.name: sorting_keys
params.description: The keys to sort the results by

params.name: sorting_order
params.description: The order to sort the results by. Must be the same length as [sortingKeys]; one order per key

items.docs: Retrieves a list of accounts with optional filters for companyId, ids, name, code and archived status. Results are paginated.

The integration sends a request to this endpoint to create a corresponding account in Pleo for any new record created in the external ERP/accounting system.
The request will fail if an account with the same `externalId` and `companyId` already exists in Pleo.

info.name: Create multiple accounts in a single request

items.docs:
Creates multiple bookkeeping accounts in a single batch operation.
This endpoint validates each account in the batch and returns both successfully created accounts and failed items with their failure reasons.
Accounts that pass validation will be created, while invalid accounts will be returned in the failed list.
